actionConfiguration.body:
SELECT
    request_id,
    requester_name,
    requester_email,
    department,
    title,
    description,
    declared_priority,
    status,
    assigned_to,
    created_at,
    due_at,
    escalated_at,

    CASE
        WHEN due_at < NOW()
            THEN '🔴 BREACHED'

        WHEN due_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
            THEN '🟡 AT RISK'

        ELSE
            '🟢 ON TRACK'
    END AS sla_status

FROM service_requests

WHERE
    (
        '{{ SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue }}' = ''
        OR status = '{{ SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue }}'
    )
    AND
    (
        '{{ SelectDepartmentFilter.selectedOptionValue }}' = ''
        OR department = '{{ SelectDepartmentFilter.selectedOptionValue }}'
    )

ORDER BY created_at DESC;

SELECT
    request_id,
    requester_name,
    requester_email,
    department,
    title,
    description,
    declared_priority,
    status,
    assigned_to,
    created_at,
    due_at,
    escalated_at,

    CASE
        WHEN due_at < NOW()
            THEN '🔴 BREACHED'

        WHEN due_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
            THEN '🟡 AT RISK'

        ELSE
            '🟢 ON TRACK'
    END AS sla_status

FROM service_requests

WHERE
    (
        '{{ SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue }}' = ''
        OR status = '{{ SelectStatus.selectedOptionValue }}'
    )
    AND
    (
        '{{ SelectDepartmentFilter.selectedOptionValue }}' = ''
        OR department = '{{ SelectDepartmentFilter.selectedOptionValue }}'
    )

ORDER BY created_at DESC;

WITH updated_request AS (
    UPDATE service_requests
    SET
        status = '{{ SelectRequestStatus.selectedOptionValue }}',
        assigned_to = NULLIF('{{ InputAssignedTo.text }}', ''),
        updated_at = NOW(),
        resolved_at = CASE
            WHEN '{{ SelectRequestStatus.selectedOptionValue }}'
                 IN ('Completed', 'Resolved')
            THEN COALESCE(resolved_at, NOW())
            ELSE NULL
        END
    WHERE request_id = '{{ TableRequests.selectedRow.request_id }}'
    RETURNING
        request_id,
        status,
        assigned_to,
        updated_at,
        resolved_at
),
audit_event AS (
    INSERT INTO request_events (
        request_id,
        event_type,
        old_status,
        new_status,
        metadata
    )
    SELECT
        u.request_id,
        'REQUEST_UPDATED',
        '{{ TableRequests.selectedRow.status }}',
        u.status,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'assigned_to', u.assigned_to
        )
    FROM updated_request u
    RETURNING id
)
SELECT
    request_id,
    status,
    assigned_to,
    updated_at,
    resolved_at
FROM updated_request;
